propositions: Gates accept operator-attested evidence on trust by design without forcing its measurement context (environment, principal, privilege posture, instrument type) into the record, making contradictions between claimed and actual observation scope invisible to repo-grounded review.

Evidence collected under broader privilege than production (e.g. live bedrock calls under bedrock:* wildcard, or policy simulators answering policy-language questions rather than service-authorization questions) cannot fail for production reasons and carries zero information about production failure modes.

Plans asserting unchanged behavior across substrate/provider/route swaps while citing no files on the configuration-consumption path are unguarded by review, because gates read only cited material and narrow scope reads as discipline rather than defect.

Stories can be signed at epic level, decomposed, and sit unreviewed at claim time while containing mechanisms that make implementations unimplementable as stated, because plan-review runs only when stories are claimed.
